Harish Salve Alleges Foreign Funding Behind Protests in India

Senior advocate Harish Salve has alleged that foreign funding and interference are behind some protests in India, suggesting a conspiracy to create instability. He stated that the Indian government should investigate these claims. The reports do not specify which protests Salve was referring to or provide further details on the alleged foreign funding.
